_comment: Wheel fitment specs, keyed by part id. E30 hub: 4x100 PCD, 57.1mm centre bore. Offsets are period-plausible for each wheel; verify against a vendor spec sheet before quoting them as fitment advice.

wheels-bbs-rs.notes: Two-piece 16x8 ET20. Needs a mild fender roll on a lowered car.

wheels-ronal-lsi.notes: Classic 15x7 ET25. Clears stock and short-spring setups.

wheels-mtech-bottle.notes: Factory M-Tech offset. Tucks slightly; no fender work needed.

wheels-borbet-a.notes: Aggressive 17x8 ET13. Expect to roll and pull the rear arches.
